title: send
description: Phone to hub, once welcomed: deliver a Draft to an agent Bucket (the `draft` Primitive's "send"). The hub answers with one `sent` carrying the same `key`. Unlike a `request`, a send changes the world, so it carries an idempotency key: the hub tries to deliver each key at most once, ever, and answers a key it has seen before with the answer it gave the first time, without trying again. The phone sends the same key again, unchanged, after a reconnect when no `sent` came, and a new key for every new "send". No capability is needed: a hub that declares a `draft` command answers it.

key.description: The idempotency key, chosen by the phone and never reused: at least 128 random bits. The `sent` carries it back.

bucket.description: The Descriptor `id` of the agent Bucket the Draft is for.

text.description: The Draft, as the person heard it read back: the prompt the agent is to receive.
